name: Interior Simulation Library
tagline: Room-by-room simulations built from the drawing set, answerable without opening them.

page.objective: Digitise an interiors drawing set room by room so any question can be answered from an index rather than from the heavy source files.
page.problem: Answering a question meant opening large drawing applications and reading them again.
page.solution: Drawings become structured scene data, get simulated, and are archived in a retrievable format behind one hub.
